data.title: Meet the Clock Hands

challenges.instruction: Touch the hand that tells us the hour.
challenges.hint: One hand is short and one is long. The short one moves slowly, all day long.

challenges.instruction: Touch the hand that tells us the minutes.
challenges.hint: One hand is short and one is long. The long one races all the way round in an hour.

challenges.instruction: Touch the hand that tells us the hour.

challenges.instruction: Touch the hand that tells us the minutes.
challenges.hint: One hand is short and one is long. The long one races all the way round in an hour.

data.description: Young learners explore the analog clock by identifying the short hour hand and the long minute hand.
